en: Black‑and‑white landscape view over a rural coastal area with fields, scattered houses, conifer trees and a bay with small boats. In the foreground are rocky outcrops, a road with an early‑mid 20th‑century car and bicycles, several tall utility poles, and a two‑storey building with signage on its facade. Printed caption text appears in the lower left corner. A small oval publisher mark with a number is in the lower right.
